parts.name: Fuel Tank
parts.desc: Gloss black paint over a sculpted steel tank, with champagne badges and a machined filler cap.

parts.name: Handlebar
parts.desc: Brushed steel bars with leather grips, a single round gauge and bar-end mirrors.

parts.name: Headlight
parts.desc: A round lamp set in a machined champagne bezel, with an amber indicator on each side.

parts.name: Front Fork
parts.desc: A telescopic fork with champagne-anodised sliders running inside black upper tubes.

parts.name: Front Wheel
parts.desc: A knobbly tyre on a champagne-finished rim, with a drilled steel disc and a bolted hub.

parts.name: Crankcase
parts.desc: A dark machined case with bolted champagne covers. The base the whole engine is built on.

parts.name: V-Twin Cylinders
parts.desc: Two finned, air-cooled cylinders set in a V, with pushrod tubes and champagne heads.

parts.name: Rear Shocks
parts.desc: Twin dampers with exposed steel springs and champagne bodies, one on each side.

parts.name: Cradle Frame
parts.desc: A matte black tubular cradle that carries the engine and ties the whole machine together.

parts.name: Exhaust
parts.desc: Brushed steel headers running into a black muffler, one pipe on each side.

parts.name: Seat
parts.desc: A single hand-stitched leather seat, kicked up at the rear.

parts.name: Tail Section
parts.desc: A slim tail that closes the line of the bike, with the rear lamp built in.

parts.name: Rear Wheel
parts.desc: A wide tyre on a matching champagne rim, with a drilled disc and a toothed drive sprocket.
